name: r80_family_development_training_v1

data_role_policy.reference_split: preserve original seed-derived role in new manifest metadata
data_role_policy.effective_profile_split: whole named canonical group including aliases is development train; every other canonical group retains its reference role
data_role_policy.parent_artifacts: immutable; fresh child protocol/workdir/models and explicit local frozen migration receipt
data_role_policy.repeat_and_nonunique: excluded from new unique learning and collection counts
data_role_policy.bootstrap: existing verified labels; zero new HFSS points; never clone old model or mutable state

unchanged_training.normalization: fit current effective training rows only

evidence_policy.old_v2_results: retained under their original protocol; never relabeled as new-model validation
evidence_policy.development_group_metrics: fit/calibration diagnostics only, not independent validation
evidence_policy.remaining_reference_holdout: descriptive regression metrics, not blanket untouched validation
evidence_policy.new_candidates: freeze model hashes, patterns, exclusions and predictions before new HFSS truth; report all outcomes
evidence_policy.unseen_group_claims: require a separately predeclared untouched whole-group cohort
evidence_policy.sm_improvement_claim: not established by this recipe or a fitted best-point residual
evidence_policy.spec_success: actual HFSS values plus separately recorded repeat; finite grid limitations remain

transition_requirements: Generated-fixture tests and independent code/role/provenance review pass before actual migration/training.
Create-only local frozen migration from an explicit verified parent data version; verify before/after source hashes and effective roles.
New model training and inference bindings pass before controller activation.
Normally stop the exact old controller at a completed cycle before integrating changed live source or starting a new watcher; distinct training roots do not enforce single ownership.
Preserve all queue/claims/raw and worker execution; do not reuse the consumed v2-bound pilot request.
Inspect real controller/process/queue readback after activation; no restart based only on an observer timeout.
